name: VERTIGO CLUB: Megastructure Urban Climb Circuit
description: The original organized urban climb circuit in Meridian 88, predating most of its competitors by a decade, running sanctioned and unsanctioned ascent routes up the exterior faces of the megastructure stack. Sanctioned routes carry corporate sponsor banners and AR checkpoint gates; unsanctioned routes run through maintenance shafts, cooling exhaust vents, and condemned structural overhangs where no corponation wants to be associated with what happens. Climbers wear minimal aug-compatible grip rigs and are ranked by time, style, and route difficulty on a public feed leaderboard.
story_hooks: A climber discovers a sealed external access point on a restricted upper stack level that shouldn't exist — and someone has been using it recently.

The leaderboard has been manipulated to push a specific unknown climber into the top-ranked position, and following their recorded routes reveals they were accessing locations that are supposedly vacuum-sealed.
A sanctioned corporate sponsor is quietly mapping every climber's biometric data through the checkpoint AR gates without consent, building a physical capability database for an unstated purpose.
